statement: For common Psi0 in H2(T^3; C^3) and chi0 in L-infinity(T^3; C), initialize the original finite system at (P_K Psi0, P_2K chi0). For every finite T>0, lim_{R->infinity} sup_{K>=1, |tau|<=T} ||(I-P_R)chi_K(tau)||_2=0. In fact the reservoirs are relatively compact in C([-T,T]; L4).
scope: Conditional pinned R-158 static P1 and R-578 finite dynamics, original nondimensional canonical time, same side-16 periodic T^3, geometric volume 4096, spatially normalized norms, and exact rectangular projection K/2K. No projection renormalization, fixed-Q rescaling, or changed Hamiltonian. Arbitrary common bounded reservoir includes non-smooth and finite Fourier preparations. General projected charges are bounded but need not be identical.
method: Conservation with P1 spectral coercivity gives uniform H2 order and L4 reservoir bounds. The pointwise auxiliary field uses the exact finite forcing at each K. A bounded Fejer approximation in the original carrier has vanishing L4 residual. Positive relative energy and skewness of the exact projected equation control the comparison in C_t L4 without an L-infinity bound on the true reservoir. Translation and temporal bounds give compactness.
verification: Source identities and 17 exact algebraic checks; separate read-only bounded-data proof using fixed smooth approximation, H2 comparison, and limsup in K before desmoothing; independent H2 bootstrap on the regular subclass; hostile L4-only/projection audit; four PDF pages individually rendered and reviewed, zero overfull hboxes. No new Lean theorem or external referee.
falsifier: An incorrect source/charge/symbol/relative-energy factor, failure of the skew projected cancellation or consistency, or escaping tails on an actual common preparation in the stated class. EXCH-008 uses differently prepared sequences and is not such a falsifier.
missing_inputs: For unbounded L4 initial reservoir data the proof lacks relative-energy stability independent of amplitude truncation; neither conclusion nor counterexample is supplied there. Full order equation limit and uniqueness are not established.
non_claims: No all-time uniform-in-T estimate, entire-sublevel tail propagation, full coupled cutoff-removal theorem, volume limit, physical state/clock, Pre-A, QFT or gravity result. T-054 and C6 T1 unchanged.
reentry: One separately authorized fixed-volume coupled-limit test: identify the unaltered P1 order first variation (especially Class-II terms) along the bounded-preparation compactness subsequences, before making any full-flow or uniqueness claim.
